content:
Apple added several products to its Certified Refurbished Store this week, including new M5 MacBook Pro models, Studio Display XDR, and high-end M5 MacBook Air configurations, among others.

A friendly reminder: Apple's Certified Refurbished Store is a great way to save money, allowing you to purchase Apple products directly from Apple's official website at up to 15% off.

The following is Apple's introduction to its Refurbished Store:

  • Outstanding quality, attractive prices
  • Undergoes a rigorous refurbishment process before being sold
  • Comes with Apple's one-year limited warranty
  • Enjoys Apple's 14-day return policy
  • AppleCare service plans can be purchased separately
  • Engraving and gift wrapping services are not available for refurbished products

One thing to note: we track every addition and removal from the Apple Certified Refurbished Store, and stock sells out fast. One of the purposes of this report is to let you know what products are currently in stock, so you can place an order before these items disappear.

What's new at the Apple Refurbished Store?

New Macs

Apple has expanded the Mac configurations offered at the Refurbished Store. Apple began selling these models earlier this year, and more stock was added this week.

The most eye-catching new arrival this time is the 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro with 512GB of storage, priced at US$1,439. Apple has discontinued this configuration, and currently the most affordable M5 model with 1TB of storage costs US$1,999.

  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air, with 4TB of storage and 24GB of memory — Midnight: US$2,969 (original price US$3,499)
  • 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro, with 512GB of storage and 16GB of memory — Space Black: US$1,439
  • 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro, with Nano-texture display, 2TB of storage and 24GB of memory — Space Black: US$2,419 (original price US$2,849)
  • 16-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro, with 4TB of storage and 24GB of memory — Silver: US$3,819 (original price US$4,499)

Apple TV 4K

The Apple TV 4K has always been a hot item at the Apple Certified Refurbished Store, and it is back in stock again this week.

  • Apple TV 4K 64GB (3rd generation) Wi-Fi version: US$169 (original price US$199)
  • Apple TV 4K 128GB (3rd generation) Wi-Fi + Ethernet version: US$209 (original price US$249)

Studio Display

  • Refurbished Studio Display XDR — Standard Glass — VESA Mount Adapter: US$2,459 (original price US$2,899)
  • Refurbished Studio Display XDR — Nano-texture Glass — VESA Mount Adapter: US$2,719 (original price US$3,199)
  • Refurbished Studio Display XDR — Standard Glass — Tilt and Height-Adjustable Stand: US$2,799 (original price US$3,299)
  • Refurbished Studio Display XDR — Nano-texture Glass — Tilt and Height-Adjustable Stand: US$3,059 (original price US$3,599)

More recommendations

Finally, Apple also added several Apple Watch configurations and other products to the Refurbished Store this week:

  • Apple Watch SE 3 GPS+Cellular, 40mm Starlight: US$249 (original price US$299)
  • Apple Watch SE GPS + Cellular, 44mm Silver: US$239 (original price US$279)
  • Apple Watch SE 3 GPS+Cellular, 44mm Midnight: US$279 (original price US$329)
  • iPhone 16 Pro 512GB — Desert Titanium (Unlocked): US$1,019 (original price US$1,199)

If you want to keep up with the latest deals on all kinds of Apple products throughout the week, you can check out 9to5Tools.
